limbs/paws or wings rendered as parallel elongated digits
justification: Both surfaces use flat, outline-driven profile figures with prominent round eyes and stacked/repeated animal motifs, and both include a bird-like beaked creature and elongated parallel digits (paws/feathers), which is a loose stylistic convergence. But the depicted subjects differ substantially: A shows a stack of quadrupeds/birds, a fringed band and a large ducklike bird with no human presence, while B shows a single composite human-headed winged figure in profile with a headdress and circle-marked wings, a scene type absent from A.
